applies_to: group S6 of docs/budgets/owner_decisions/OWNER_QUESTIONS_SEQUENCED_v1.md (A9.7 F1/F2/F3/F4/F7-F8/F9 lane questions and UPSTREAM_ICD-Q1)
checkpoint_6_merge: APPROVED in this message (one merge): A9.7 verified design synthesis + A9.8-A9.12 decision records, as PR ppusapati/abep#36; S1-S5 decisions stay text-only at that checkpoint

F1Q-02.summary: honeycomb structure as labelled PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY for budgeting only (no CBE, frozen mass or structural claim); sourced buildable definition mandatory before LOCK-1

F1Q-03.summary: 0/2/5 deg sensitivity only; register the AOCS relative-wind pointing envelope first, build intake surface v2 over it, direct TPMC meanwhile, never extrapolate beyond the frozen angular domain

F2-OQ-01.summary: baseline protects the compressor against intake-borne particulates, debris, released particulates; atomic O is propellant (not removed); charged-particle removal not baseline; no credit for compressor wear products (separate downstream guard if needed); quantitative acceptance (capture vs class, species transmission, conductance penalty, O recombination, capacity, AO durability, AG-12 effect) pre-registered before LOCK-1 from evidence

F2-OQ-02.summary: inert/low-recombination baseline; catalytic O->O2 only as a separately labelled research/contingency variant with its own conversion, flow, qualification and H-1 map

F2-OQ-03.summary: FC-00 analytical reference bound only, never an admissible flight architecture

F2-OQ-04.summary: intake/channel array -> filter -> compressor inlet; axial location/area/thermal state remain variables; APP-FILTER added to P4 (AO exposure, erosion, recombination, retention, thermal cycling, transmission)

OQ-F3-02.summary: hub ratio/radius and blade span explicit design variables; zero-hub only as an analytical bound; no invented numerical bounds before shaft/bearing/structural/motor/manufacturing/pumping interfaces exist

OQ-F3-03.summary: open-literature transitional-regime model now + T-1/T-2 characterization in parallel; until admitted/validated, > 0.1 Pa results are NOT_EVALUATED_OUT_OF_DOMAIN and never valid architecture points

OQ-F3-04.summary: Al and CFRP rotors re-admitted only with an S2.3 strength basis; CFRP also laminate, directional allowables, environment basis, manufacturing/inspection, AO disposition

OQ-F4-01.summary: orbit-state-scheduled plenum setpoint is the baseline (only controller-available state variables); fixed setpoint retained as degraded-mode fallback and comparison; schedule not frozen until validated domains exist

OQ-F4-02.summary: primary direction: compressor/feed chain producing the H-1-required pressure/flow state (extend compressor regime per S6.8, measure the H-1 inlet requirement, design valve/line/isolator/distributor to the admitted feed state); <= 0.1 Pa high-conductance branch kept as sensitivity/fallback only

OQ-F4-03.summary: 2 % band, 60 s window, E0-E7, modulation cases and outputs retained as the pre-LOCK-2 characterization framework; final tolerances from measured H-1 feed sensitivity at LOCK-2; a tighter H-1 limit governs

OQ-F4-04.summary: order: performance-derived requirement (S6.21), capture within drag/mass/pointing, compressor domain/pumping/feed efficiency, scheduled setpoint; dense-state-only operation a sensitivity only if it violates S6.15; 0.38 mg/s is not a flight requirement

OQ-F4-05.summary: rule-1 versioned orbit-resolved frozen atmosphere (state, density, composition, temperature, wind, solar/geomagnetic inputs, local time/orbit position, source/version, provenance/hashes); orbit-averaged dataset kept unchanged; no invented amplitude

OQ-F78-01.summary: T_available(state) - D_spacecraft(state) >= 0 at every required state 180-230 km, same-state evaluation; report statewise, worst-state and orbit-averaged margins; negative intervals only by a future owner decision

OQ-F78-02.summary: robust feasibility across every admitted Maxwell/CLL/accommodation scenario until DI-1.3; then a pre-registered measurement-to-range mapping narrows the set, full-range cases kept as sensitivities

OQ-F78-03.summary: hard constraints first (AG-12, AG-13, power, mass, thermal, material/life, H-1 feed-quality incl. ripple vs measured H-1 tolerance); then Pareto over worst-state margin, drag, upstream power, mass, volume, heat-rejection burden; no weighted scalar

OQ-F78-04.summary: documented/public/official spacecraft geometry allowed for REFERENCE/PARAMETRIC drag studies; AG-13 closure requires the host-spacecraft ICD; until then D_spacecraft and T-D NOT_EVALUATED for freeze

UPSTREAM_ICD-Q1.summary: filter is a distinct production element between IF-A1 and IF-A2 exposing species forward/reverse transmission, conductance, conversion, retained inventory, thermal load, material state, validity flags; not hidden in intake efficiency

F9-OQ-01.summary: carry a versioned robust Pareto set; current 9 members not frozen (regenerated after S2 fixes, intake v2, filter, expanded compressor search, T-1/T-2, DI-1.3); single-point studies evaluate all members or label an engineering reference

F9-OQ-02.summary: no fixed mg/s flight gate (neither 0.38 nor ~1.3 mg/s); AG-12 = statewise feed-state sufficiency: required drag-compensation thrust from the registered drag basis -> minimum feed state (mass flow, pressure, temperature, composition, ripple quality) from the validated H-1 map within power/thermal envelope -> upstream must deliver it; NOT_EVALUATED until the H-1 map exists; 0.38-3.2 mg/s is characterization coverage only

F9-OQ-03.summary: gates approved; closure only on determining evidence (test, validated analysis where permitted, inspected/weighed/certified configuration, official requirement documents); AG-03 via a new pre-registered held-out validation (P5-N2 v1 stays INCONCLUSIVE); AG-12 per S6.21; AG-13 per S6.15; AG-15 requires the official RFP registered with immutable provenance/hash and the RVM re-based on it; all 15 closed before FROZEN_REFERENCE_FLIGHT_ARCHITECTURE

owner_statements.flight_flow_requirement: 0.38 mg/s and ~1.3 mg/s are not flight requirements; the delivered-flow shortfall vs 0.38 mg/s is an engineering warning, not a demonstrated requirement failure; the governing question is whether the delivered feed lets the measured H-1 produce the required 12-25 mN drag compensation within < 1.5 kW and < 40 kg
owner_statements.xenon: the RFP expects ambient-air operation and Xe capability; Xe stays contingency-only for C1, while the propulsion system still needs the RFP-required Xe capability

recorder_notes: 'RFP(1)' markers cite the official RFP document the owner holds; it is not yet in the repository, so AG-15 (and any requirement re-basing) needs the document registered with provenance/hash
